The data are expected to further inform development of the BCMA-directed therapy across autoimmune diseases.

The NDA submission is based on data from the Phase 3 REZILIENT3 trial, which met its primary endpoint at interim analysis, demonstrating a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in median progression-free survival for zipalertinib plus chemotherapy compared to chemotherapy alone.

Completion of the NDA submission is expected in November. o An NDA for zipalertinib monotherapy for relapsed EGFR ex20ins NSCLC remains under review with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act target action date of February 27, 2027. o Cullinan is eligible to receive $30 million and $100 million upon U.S. regulatory approvals for the treatment of 2L and 1L EGFR ex20ins NSCLC, respectively, and a 50/50 profit share in the U.S. o New data from Cohort C of the Phase 2 REZILIENT2 study were presented at the ESMO Congress 2026, reinforcing the clinically meaningful intracranial antitumor activity of zipalertinib monotherapy in patients with active brain metastases.
